questions.q: Menopause is associated with a rapid decline in estrogen, which accelerates bone loss. What is the recommended daily calcium intake for women over age 50?
questions.explain: The RDA for calcium increases from 1000 mg to 1200 mg for women > 50 years to mitigate post-menopausal bone loss.
